d3580c33a2682b88.description: Industry: Beauty & Cosmetics Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Employment Type: Full-Time, On-Site Number of Vacancies: 3 About the Role We are seeking motivated and sales-driven Beauty Sales Specialists to join a growing business in the beauty and cosmetics industry, specializing in premium international beauty brands and professional nail care products. The business supplies high-end products to professional salons and individual customers across Saudi Arabia, while also offering professional training, certifications, and salon consultation services. As a Beauty Sales Specialist, you will be responsible for developing new business opportunities, building strong relationships with salon owners and beauty professionals, and driving sales growth by promoting a portfolio of premium international beauty brands. Key Responsibilities Drive Sales & Business Growth: Achieve sales targets through proactive client acquisition, upselling, cross-selling, and relationship management. Develop New Clients: Identify and approach potential salon clients, arrange meetings, present products, and expand the customer base. Build Client Relationships: Maintain strong, long-term relationships with salon owners, beauty professionals, and existing customers. Product Knowledge & Demonstrations: Demonstrate product usage, explain features and benefits, and stay updated on the latest beauty and nail care trends. Product Presentation: Ensure professional product displays, proper stock availability, and high visual merchandising standards. Market Development: Identify new business opportunities, gather client feedback, and support promotional activities and sales initiatives. Sales Reporting: Monitor sales performance, track customer interactions, and contribute to achieving business objectives. Client Visits: Travel to salons across Riyadh to conduct meetings, introduce products, and develop new business opportunities. Strong knowledge of nail care products, manicure and pedicure tools, cosmetics, and beauty trends. Proven sales, negotiation, and customer relationship management skills. Ability to identify new business opportunities and confidently approach potential clients. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. d36646529401fa56.description: Devision: Sports and Entertainment Department: AKUN Compnay: Sports and Entertainment Compnay From Land to Sea – Active Experiences in Nature’s Purest Form Red Sea Sports & Entertainment (RSSE) is a dedicated subsidiary of Red Sea Global (RSG) , responsible for designing and delivering outstanding land and marine experiences at The Red Sea destination . RSSE manages and operates a diverse portfolio of sports, adventure, and leisure offerings, including water sports through Galaxea , adventure activities via Akun , and leisure experiences delivered by WAMA . RSSE plays a key strategic role in the partnership between Red Sea Global and the Saudi Olympic & Paralympic Committee , united by a shared ambition to promote inclusive, accessible, and world-class sports and recreational experiences. Guided by a purpose-driven approach and a strong commitment to people and the planet, RSSE delivers innovative programs aligned with Saudi Vision 2030 , supporting the Kingdom’s ambition to become a global leader in regenerative tourism. Red Sea Sport & Entertainment – Where Nature Inspires Elevated Adventure. The role supports the ongoing development of a diverse network of trails and adventure activities, ensuring exceptional guest experiences aligned with Red Sea Sport & Entertainment standards. The Instructor works collaboratively with senior instructors, operations teams, resort colleagues, and guests, leading adventure activities while upholding the highest levels of safety, environmental stewardship, and customer service. This position is central to showcasing the destination’s natural landscape while delivering world-class adventure programming. Key Responsibilities Deliver and support the operation of all inland, land-based adventure activities across The Red Sea destination. Lead guests on Akun Adventure experiences, ensuring safety, engagement, and a premium, memorable outdoor experience. Conduct clear and professional pre-activity briefings, including safety instructions, risk awareness, and experience expectations. Ensure strict adherence to all safety protocols, SOPs, RAMS, and emergency procedures during all activities. Educate guests on environmental awareness, conservation principles, and responsible outdoor behavior in line with RSSE sustainability values. Maintain a professional, welcoming, and service-oriented approach when interacting with guests at all times. Monitor weather conditions, terrain, and guest capability, adjusting activity plans to ensure safety and experience quality. Assist with trail exploration and assessment to identify optimal routes that deliver high-end and safe adventure experiences. Support trip planning, logistics, equipment preparation, and vehicle readiness prior to and during activities. Provide feedback, operational insights, and incident reports to the Senior Instructor and RSSE management as required. Support the maintenance and care of all adventure equipment, ensuring cleanliness, readiness, and compliance with safety standards. Assist in the training, mentoring, and development of Adventure Specialists and junior team members. Promote and embody the unique Red Sea service style, ensuring consistent delivery of high-quality guest experiences. Maintain positive and professional conduct with guests, colleagues, and stakeholders in all circumstances. Policies, Systems, Processes & Reporting Comply with all RSSE and Red Sea Global policies, processes, SOPs, and operational guidelines to ensure consistent and controlled service delivery. Support the preparation of accurate and timely operational reports and MIS data in line with corporate and departmental requirements. Safety, Quality & Environment Apply safety, quality, and environmental management policies to ensure employee and guest safety, regulatory compliance, service excellence, and responsible environmental practices. Actively contribute to a strong safety culture by identifying hazards, reporting risks, and supporting continuous risk mitigation. Continuous Improvement Contribute to identifying opportunities for continuous improvement across adventure operations, systems, and guest experiences, aligned with international best practices and operational excellence. Key Stakeholders Internal: Senior Instructors, Adventure Operations, RSSE Operations Teams, Resort & Hospitality Teams External: Guests, Local Authorities, Environmental & Outdoor Activity Partners Job Requirements Qualifications & Experience Valid Wilderness First Aid or internationally recognized First Aid certification. Basic Land Navigation training, including natural navigation and GPS usage. Leave No Trace certification or equivalent environmental training. Search, Tracking & Operations training. Trekking / Mountain Leader certification (IFMGA, UIAA, or BMC preferred). Additional National Governing Body (NGB) certifications from accredited providers (e.g., Mountain Biking, Climbing, Archery, High Ropes, Quad Biking). Minimum of two (2) to three (3) years’ experience within the tourism, adventure, or outdoor recreation industry; experience in Saudi Arabia is an advantage. Skills & Competencies Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced outdoor environment. Flexible, adaptable, and resourceful with strong problem-solving skills. Demonstrated experience within adventure, sports, or outdoor organizations. Strong teamwork and collaboration skills within multicultural environments. Ability to identify operational hazards and strictly follow SOPs and RAMS to mitigate risk. Willingness to learn, accept guidance, and pursue ongoing professional development. Strong commitment to service excellence, safety, and quality. Self-motivated with a proactive approach to personal and professional growth. Fluency in spoken and written English is required; Arabic or an additional language is a strong advantage. Additional Attributes Strong team player with a positive attitude Ability to follow instructions and operational direction Cultural awareness and sensitivity Clear and effective communication skills High adaptability to changing conditions Consistently customer-focused with a passion for delivering exceptional experiences Job Context This role operates primarily in outdoor and remote environments across The Red Sea destination and requires physical fitness, environmental awareness, and flexibility in working hours. The Instructor is expected to represent Akun Adventure and Red Sea Sport & Entertainment with professionalism, integrity, and enthusiasm at all times.

The role provides high-level technical support and expertise to the Vice-President Finance (VPF), enabling informed decision-making on critical issues within the Finance & CFO Complex. This includes domains such as financial control, treasury and liquidity management, financial sustainability, investments, and financial policies. The Principal Executive Coordinator also facilitates communication and coordination with internal units and external stakeholders, including investors, rating agencies, financial institutions, and development partners. Strategy and Operational Planning Lead the development, implementation, and monitoring of Annual Work Plans and KPIs for the Office of the Vice-President Finance & CFO. Ensure the effective and proactive operation of the Office, both internally and externally, to deliver required services. Formulate, develop, and implement policies, procedures, and guidelines for the Office. Prepare annual resource plans and budgets for the Office. Contribute to the preparation, review, and implementation of annual internal and external engagement plans to enhance IsDB's standing. Technical Advisory and Executive Support Provide professional and technical advice to the Vice-President on assigned domains or other matters. Offer technical advisory support to the Vice-President on Finance & CFO Complex matters referred by Management Committees or Boards. Review briefing materials, correspondence, and communications for the Vice-President to ensure quality and thoroughness. Advise on improving business efficiency, effectiveness, responsiveness, and quality within the Finance & CFO Complex. Recommend reviews and improvements to Bank policies, procedures, processes, and guidelines based on lessons learned and global best practices. Conduct analysis on development issues with policy implications and provide technical opinions. Communicate Vice-President's directives to concerned departments in a timely and effective manner. Review correspondence requiring the Vice-President's attention, prioritize, and forward to relevant units. Follow up on actions and instructions from concerned units and report on progress. Accompany the Vice-President in internal and external engagements as required. Knowledge Sharing and Innovation Propose innovative ideas to enhance work efficiency within the Front Office. Review and improve policies, objectives, and programs through benchmarking. Recommend innovation and knowledge-sharing initiatives. Champion initiatives to improve the performance and innovative contributions of the VPF Front Office team. Leadership and Team Development Lead the provision of advisory services and technical guidance for all Finance & CFO Complex activities. Provide motivational leadership for the Front Office team and advise the VPF on staff performance and expectations. Assist the VPF in managing Front Office team performance and resources, including delegation, objective setting, feedback, and addressing underperformance. Advise the VPF on assessing Front Office team skills and capabilities, and determining actions for increased impact. Counsel the VPF on addressing capability gaps through capacity development and recruitment within the Front Office. Coach, mentor, and develop Front Office staff. Act as a role model for the team regarding IsDB's values and leadership competencies, providing direction and support during change. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess over 10 years of relevant experience in a similar executive coordination or technical advisory capacity, preferably within a financial institution or development bank. The role requires strong analytical skills, comprehensive understanding of financial control, treasury, investments, and financial policies, and the ability to provide strategic advice to senior leadership. Reporting and Communication Provide the Vice-President with periodic or ad-hoc reports on development issues in assigned regions. Liaise with stakeholders to plan and resolve issues related to the Vice-President's Office.

d38eb484015804d3.job_title: Future Career Opportunity - Attraction Manager - Jazan
d38eb484015804d3.description: Job Purpose: Responsible for leading the daily operations of the offering within the Attractions department, ensuring that they run smoothly, efficiently, and meet high guest service standards. This role includes managing procurement, inventory, budgeting, scheduling, and business planning. Will be leading the daily operations of the attraction. tasked with ensuring operational compliance, safety, and financial success while leading a team to provide an exceptional guest experience. Monitor and evaluate the performance of the offering, making data-driven decisions to enhance efficiency and guest experience. Business Planning • Set and review long-term plans to align with SEVEN’s strategy and guest needs. • Identify process improvements and explore new opportunities to enhance offerings and reduce costs. Procurement and Inventory Management • Oversee the procurement process for all goods and services required for the attraction, ensuring timely delivery and cost-effective sourcing. • Manage inventory control processes, including receiving goods, tracking inventory levels, and maintaining accurate records to prevent shortages or overstocking. • Establish relationships with vendors and suppliers to ensure the consistent and reliable supply of goods necessary for attraction operations. Stakeholder Relations • Build and maintain strong relationships with key internal stakeholders, including Attractions GM, other department managers, and staff members to ensure effective communication and coordination. • Represent the offering in cross-functional meetings, ensuring that the offering’s needs and challenges are addressed. • Engage with external stakeholders, such as suppliers and partners, to secure resources and support for operational needs. Budget and Scheduling Management • Oversee the budgeting process for the offering, ensuring alignment with departmental financial goals and SEVEN’s overall budgetary policies. • Monitor expenditure throughout the fiscal year, ensuring all spending is in line with the approved budget and identifying opportunities for cost savings. • Oversee the scheduling of staff and resources to optimize operational efficiency while controlling costs and maintaining high service standards. • Provide regular financial reports to Attractions GM, highlighting any variances and proposing corrective actions where necessary. Governance and Resilience • Develop and implement operational policies and procedures for the offering, ensuring compliance with SEVEN’s standards and regulations. • Lead risk management initiatives to identify potential operational challenges and develop contingency plans to mitigate risks. • Ensure that all health and safety regulations are strictly adhered to, promoting a safe and secure environment for both guests and staff. People Management • Direct the recruitment, training, and performance management of the team, ensuring that all staff members are equipped to deliver exceptional service. • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and professional development within the team, providing coaching and mentorship as needed. • Conduct regular performance evaluations, providing constructive feedback and setting clear goals for team members. • Cultivate an inclusive work environment where team members are engaged, motivated, and supported in their roles. Functional Accountabilities: Daily Operations Management • Oversee the day-to-day operations of the offering, ensuring all activities are executed smoothly and efficiently. • Coordinate staff schedules to ensure optimal coverage and productivity, addressing any staffing issues promptly. • Manage inventory levels, ensuring that all necessary supplies are available to meet operational demands. Financial Management • Manage the financial performance of the attraction, ensuring that revenue targets are met, and costs are controlled within the budget. • Prepare detailed financial reports, including budget forecasts, actuals, and variance analyses, for review by senior management. • Collaborate with the finance team to ensure the accuracy of financial records and compliance with SEVEN’s financial policies and audit requirements. Optimization and Innovation • Identify and implement opportunities for operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness within the offering. • Collaborate with Attractions GM and other managers to innovate and improve the offerings and processes. • Stay updated on industry trends and best practices, ensuring that SEVEN’s operations remain competitive and innovative. Scheduling and Resource Management • Develop and maintain efficient scheduling systems for staff, attractions, and events to optimize resources and ensure seamless operations. • Work closely with the HR team to ensure that all shifts are adequately staffed, and employee scheduling adheres to labor laws and internal policies. • Monitor resource allocation to ensure the attraction operates within the established budget and staffing plan. Guest Experience • Lead efforts to ensure all guest interactions are positive and welcoming. • Address and resolve guest complaints promptly, implementing solutions to enhance satisfaction and build loyalty. • Monitor guest feedback and performance metrics, using insights to continuously improve the overall guest experience. KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE: Minimum Qualifications • Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, Business Administration, or a related field. Professional Certifications • Certification in Operations Management or Project Management is preferred. EXPERIENCE Required Experience • 10+ years of relevant experience in operations management within the entertainment or hospitality sectors, with at least 5 years in a leadership role. • Proven track record of managing large teams and complex operations in a guest-facing environment. • Experience in optimizing operations for efficiency and guest satisfaction, with a strong focus on innovation and continuous improvement. d326c703d293aabb.job_title: Chief Clinical Officer (CCO) (Senior Healthcare Experience Essential) 50013023
d326c703d293aabb.description: JOB PURPOSE Key internal interfaces include the CEO, executive leadership team, healthcare asset leaders, quality and patient safety teams, clinical operations, digital health, legal and compliance, talent acquisition, and partnership teams. Key external interfaces include regulators, accreditation bodies, clinical partners, academic institutions, sports federations, professional teams, and other strategic healthcare partners. The Chief Medical Officer (CMO) is QHC’s most senior clinical executive and the single accountable owner of enterprise clinical strategy, medical governance, quality, patient and athlete safety, and clinical standards across all QHC healthcare assets. Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, the CMO brings clinical leadership, standards-setting, assurance, and medical advisory authority under one role, ensuring clear and consistent clinical accountability while operational delivery remains with the respective healthcare businesses and functions. The CMO ensures that clinical delivery across all QHC healthcare assets follows the QHC’s clinical and wellness standards, quality expectations, and readiness requirements, reflecting international evidence-based practice and applicable Saudi regulatory requirements. As a member of the QHC executive leadership team, the CMO translates the Kingdom's Vision 2030 and Qiddiya’s healthcare ambitions into governed, accountable practice, championing patient and athlete safety, clinical research and academic collaboration, and positioning QHC as a regionally recognized centre of clinical excellence. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES The role sets enterprise clinical standards, quality expectations, and governance requirements for all QHC healthcare assets, while day-to-day operational delivery, staffing deployment, and business-unit execution remain accountable to the relevant operating leaders. 1. Enterprise Clinical Strategy & Medical Affairs • Provide overall clinical leadership and set the enterprise clinical strategy for QHC across all current and future service lines, in alignment with the QIC and Vision 2030 healthcare transformation objectives. • Serve as the principal clinical voice on the executive leadership team, advising the CEO / MD and the Board and Medical Advisory Committee on clinical strategy, service development, clinical risk and medical policy. • Provide clinical and wellness input into service models and define the clinical standards, quality expectations and readiness requirements for all healthcare assets. • Represent QHC's clinical capabilities to sports federations, professional teams, government stakeholders, regulators and strategic partners. 2. Clinical Governance, Quality & Patient / Athlete Safety • Establish QHC’s overarching clinical governance and quality framework, setting expectations for patient and athlete safety, clinical quality, risk and compliance across all healthcare assets. • Provide a consistent enterprise-wide framework for clinical quality and accountability, ensuring clear standards and expectations across all healthcare assets. • Define, monitor, and report enterprise clinical KPIs and quality dashboards for clinical partnership or assets under direct operation of QHC. • Define clinical governance and escalation requirements, ensure appropriate review of priority quality, safety, and service issues, and provide senior clinical guidance on corrective actions, risk mitigation, and follow-up accountability. 3. Clinical Excellence, Protocols & Care Pathways • Set QHC’s enterprise clinical excellence, safety and wellness standards across all healthcare assets, aligned with evidence-based international practice and applicable Saudi regulatory requirements • Provide clinical and wellness guidance to all healthcare assets on service models, safety requirements and areas for clinical improvement • Develop and continuously review clinical policies, evidence-based care pathways, treatment protocols and standard operating procedures of clinical partners and QHC operated assets aligned with international best practice. • Promote evidence-based, person-centred models of care that integrate physical, psychological and social dimensions of health, wellbeing and performance, as relevant to the populations served. • Set enterprise clinical requirements for documentation, information governance, patient confidentiality and related clinical compliance, in line with applicable Saudi regulatory requirements and relevant international standards. 4. Sports Medicine & Citywide Healthcare Clinical Advisory • Provide clinical and wellness advisory support to all healthcare assets, providing input into service models, clinical readiness requirements, quality expectations and relevant performance measures. • Advise on multidisciplinary and integrated approaches to care, supporting alignment with QHC’s clinical standards and evidence-based practice. • Provide clinical guidance on priority service areas and readiness requirements, identifying clinical gaps, risks and opportunities for improvement. 5. Partnerships, Research & Academic Collaboration • Contribute to the development and implementation of clinical partnerships with institutions by supporting knowledge exchange, capability building, and the integration of leading practices into clinical care. • Support research, innovation, and academic collaboration initiatives, facilitating clinical engagement in research, education, and evidence-generation activities. • Participate in evaluating and adopting emerging clinical technologies, digital health solutions, and clinical analytics that enhance clinical practice and support data-driven decision-making. Role success will be measured by the design and deployment of all QHC healthcare assets, engagement of QHC clinical partnerships, achievement of clinical readiness milestones, compliance with applicable Saudi regulatory and accreditation requirements, adoption of approved clinical standards and care pathways, strength of clinical partner engagement, and sustained improvement in patient and athlete safety, quality and cost indicators through value based care. EXPERIENCE & ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS Medical degree (MD, MBBS, MBChB, or equivalent) with board certification or postgraduate specialty qualification in a relevant discipline is required. Additional qualifications or experience in clinical leadership, sports medicine, population health or related fields are preferred Active registration and licensure with the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS) at Consultant level, or clear eligibility for SCFHS Consultant classification, is required. Dataflow primary source verification and SCFHS Mumaris Plus registration must be completed prior to commencement. 15+ years of progressive clinical experience, with a substantial track record in senior clinical leadership, medical director or chief-level roles within accredited healthcare institutions. Experience delivering care to professional athletes, elite teams or comparable high-performance environments is highly desirable. Proven expertise in clinical governance, patient-safety management, multidisciplinary team leadership and quality improvement within a regulated healthcare environment. Prior experience in JCI and/or CBAHI accredited institutions and within partnership or joint-venture clinical models is highly preferred. Strong working knowledge of Saudi MOH and SCFHS licensing and regulatory frameworks, and of the clinical operating requirements of a startup or greenfield healthcare organization.
